description: List the keywords used to classify Polish legal acts, optionally only those containing a phrase. search-acts matches keywords exactly (cywilny finds no acts, kodeks cywilny finds hundreds), so look them up here first.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 200

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

query.description: Part of a keyword to look for, ignoring case and Polish diacritics (e.g. podat); omit to page through all of about 2,500

name: get-act-keywords

items.description: Keyword, as accepted by the keywords of search-acts

nextOffset.description: Pass as `offset` to get the next page; absent on the last page

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

offset.description: Number of matching items skipped before this page

total.description: Number of matching items on all pages

title: List keywords of legal acts
